item.title: India’s Unacademy sells to rival upGrad for $206M, about 94% less than its peak valuation
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: "We raised at a peak, but sold at a fraction of that," Unacademy co-founder and CEO Gaurav Munjal wrote. "I'm not going to dress these facts up."

item.title: Magna increases bet on battery swapping in India with $35M for Yuma
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Magna's investment in Yuma Energy has reached $87 million as the Canadian auto supplier increases its majority stake in the Indian battery-swapping firm.

item.title: Lachy Groom backs Indian startup aiming to keep aircraft aloft for a year
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Founded by a 20-year-old, Alteon is developing autonomous aircraft that hopes to harvest wind energy to stay aloft for several months.

item.title: Apply now to host a Side Event at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Apply before September 4 to be a part of the TechCrunch Disrupt community by hosting your own Side Event.

item.title: Harvard Law dropout raises $6M for Blue Voice to build a ‘Harvey for police officers’
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: Blue Voice is trained on department-specific laws, local ordinances, protocols, and guidelines that general-purpose AI tools can't access on the public internet.

item.title: Ryan Breslow is raising up to $27M in pay-to-play bridge funding to save Bolt
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: The controversial founder of the checkout startup once valued at $11 billion is putting in $5 million of his own money.

item.title: Clipto uses AI to search terabytes of video and is now valued at $250M
item.dc:creator: Kate Park
item.description: The three-year-old startup says it reached $15 million in ARR and profitability before raising its latest $15 million round.

item.title: Meeting note-taker Circleback adds a free tier to attract more customers
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Circleback is also introducing new pricing plans starting from $14 per month.

item.title: Liux’s Big microcar bets on sustainability to take on Chinese rivals
item.dc:creator: Anna Heim
item.description: The Liux Big microcar is made in Spain. The startup thinks it can compete in a crowded market with its tiny electric car built around sustainability.

item.title: How Sweden built one of Europe’s hottest startup ecosystems
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Sophia Bendz, general partner at Cherry Ventures, stopped by Equity to break down the latest in the Swedish tech ecosystem.

item.title: As electric two-wheelers gain a foothold, Belgian startup Any bets on cargo space
item.dc:creator: Anna Heim
item.description: Launched by Belgian startup Any, LUV1 is a modular electric motorcycle with 120 liters of cargo space that can be used to carry bags, work equipment, or even pets.

item.title: AI, athletes, and Keith Rabois: StrictlyVC is back in New York on September 10
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: A boutique StrictlyVC evening returns to New York's West Village on September 10 with Keith Rabois, Craig Shapiro, Jason Levien, Tristan Walker, Brynn Putnam, and Deven Parekh — covering AI, sports investing, community-building, venture economics, and politics, with cocktails, food, and networking throughout the night.

item.title: Fashion startup Atorie raises $9.5M to bring consumers luxury goods without the markup
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Shoppers can visit the Atorie website and buy handbags or clothes made from the same material — and coming from the same factory — that manufacturers use in high-end goods.

item.title: Hoomanely’s building a smart feeding bowl and an AI platform to help owners spot when their pup is sick
item.dc:creator: Ram Iyer
item.description: Hoomanely has developed a smart bowl to measure and record dogs' feeding data, then tells owners if behaviors change.

item.title: This former PG&E engineer is building a ‘Google Maps for the underground’
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: The startup just raised a $26 million Series A to grow its customer base and help reduce red tape for utility and construction work.

item.title: Viral AI startup Instinct has raised $350M at a $2.5B valuation
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: The startup is only a year old but it has already generated a massive amount of hype (and money) while also spurring privacy concerns.

item.title: Flipboard acquires Graze, the feed builder working to monetize the open social web
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Flipboard is acquiring Bluesky feed-building startup Graze, bringing its privacy-friendly ad technology and creator monetization tools into Flipboard’s growing open social web ecosystem.
